units: Cant. R. to III, 4 ד׳ קשה of the various expressions for prophecy dibbur is the severest; Gen. R. s. 44; Macc. 11ᵃ; (Sifre Num. 99 דִּבֵּר).

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 1:13">Lev. R. s. 1</cite> (play on <he>ויקר</he>, <cite ref="Numbers 23:4">Num. XXIII, 4</cite>, a. <cite ref="F00049"><he>ויקרא</he></cite> <cite ref="Leviticus 1:1">Lev. I, 1</cite>) the Lord reveals Himself to the gentile prophets <he>בחצי ד׳</he> only with half a word (defective revelation), opp. <he>ד׳ שלם</he>.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 28:4">Ex. R. s. 28</cite> <he>ד׳ זכור וכ׳</he> the commandment, ‘Remember the Sabbath’.
Y. Ned. III, 37ᵈ bot.; a. fr.—תוך כדי ד׳, v. דַּי.—Esp. הַדִּ׳ revelation, Divine Speech, (hypostasized) the Word, the Dibbur.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 1:13">Lev. R. s. 1</cite>, beg. <he>קול הד׳ עצמו</he> the direct voice of the Dibbur.
<cite ref="Yevamot 5b">Yeb. 5ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>לפני הד׳</he> prior to the revelation.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:2:2">Cant. R. to I, 2</cite>; a. fr.—<he>על פי הד׳</he> following the Divine order.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 7:2:46">Y. Sabb. VII, 10ᶜ</cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>דִּיבּוּרִים</he>, <he>דִּיכּוּרִין</he>, <he>דִּבּ׳</he>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 38">Gen. R. s. 38</cite> <he>ד׳ אחדים</he> mysterious words (accounts), v. <cite ref="A00994"><he>אֶחָד</he></cite>. Cant. R. l. c.; a. fr. V. <cite ref="D00077"><he>דָּבָר</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Shabbat 63a:17">Sabb. 63ᵃ</cite> <he>אין ד׳ אלא נחת</he> the root <he>דבר</he> (in <cite ref="Malachi 3:16">Mal. III, 16</cite> <he>נדברו</he>) means submission; <cite ref="Makkot 11a:2">Macc. 11ᵃ</cite> (corr. acc.).
